title: helm-run-v1 — a Helm evidence bundle exported as an in-toto predicate (HELM-INTOTO-EXPORT-1)
description: The predicate carried by an in-toto Statement v1 whose subject is a Helm evidence bundle (bundle.json) and whose predicateType is https://ainumbers.co/attestation/helm-run/v1. Digest-level only: no raw payload, no secret-shaped field survives the exporter (the same redaction backstop hub/bundle.mjs already enforces upstream). Fields the source bundle carries as digest-level record are required; the three provenance fields that only some bundle producers seal (workflow_id, execution_hash, kernel_digest) are conditional — the exporter copies them from the bundle's own DSSE-signed statements verbatim and fails closed if the same field is found with conflicting values.

run_id.description: Copied verbatim from the bundle manifest predicate's run_id.

workflow_id.description: Copied from a sealed object statement's workflow_id field when the bundle carries one.

manifest_digest.description: The bundle's workflow_manifest_digest as recorded in (and signed by) the bundle manifest itself.

execution_hash.description: The run's OCG execution_hash as recorded in a sealed object statement; present only when the bundle carries it.

kernel_digest.description: The executed kernel's pinned digest as recorded in a sealed object statement; present only when the bundle carries it.

steps.description: One entry per sealed object statement that carries a step_id and output_digest, in bundle order.

trust_labels.description: The distinct §26.6 trust labels covering the bundle's manifest entries, sorted so the list is canonical.

bundle_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the bundle file's raw bytes — the same digest the Statement's subject binds, so the subject and the predicate agree.
